CheckTitle: ELB HTTPS listener enforces TLS 1.2 or higher
Description: **Huawei Cloud Elastic Load Balance (ELB)** HTTPS listeners use a modern **TLS security policy** enforcing **TLS 1.2 or TLS 1.3** (`tls-1-2`, `tls-1-2-strict`, `tls-1-2-fs`, `tls-1-3`) and disable deprecated **TLS 1.0 / 1.1**.
Risk: Deprecated **TLS 1.0** and **TLS 1.1** protocols contain known cryptographic weaknesses and are non-compliant with modern security standards.

Code.Other:
1. Log on to the **Huawei Cloud console**.
2. Navigate to **Elastic Load Balance (ELB)** > **Load Balancers**.
3. Select the load balancer and edit the target **HTTPS** listener.
4. Set **TLS Security Policy** to **tls-1-2-strict**, **tls-1-2-fs-with-1-3**, or **tls-1-3**.
5. Save the configuration.

Recommendation.Text: Configure ELB HTTPS listeners with a **TLS 1.2+** security policy and disable TLS 1.0 and TLS 1.1.
